title: LA School District Blocks Google AI Search Features
excerpt: Los Angeles schools restrict Google's AI search functions after the company stated AI overviews and regular search cannot be separated.
body_html:
The Los Angeles school district has blocked Google's artificial intelligence search features.

According to the school system, Google stated that its AI overviews and standard search capabilities function as a mandatory package deal.

As a result, the district took action to restrict these AI search tools from being used.
